sloka: तथैव रावणेनापि पात्यमाना मुहुर्मुहुः ।अर्जुनोरसि निर्भाति गदोल्केव महागिरौ ।। ७.३२.५७ ॥
transliteration: tathaiva rāvaṇenāpi pātyamānā muhurmuhuḥ ।arjunorasi nirbhāti gadolkeva mahāgirau ।। 7.32.57 ॥

translations.english: Similarly, Ravana's mace, struck repeatedly on Arjuna's chest, shone like a meteor striking a great mountain.
translations.hindi: ओर हर्षित हो उससे कहा-मेरे महाबली भाइ रावण यहाँ आए हुए हें
